name: Garden of Caro
source:
When Caroline loses her job as a Sous Chef due to unfair circumstances, she's left drowning in self-doubt and stacks of bills that need to be paid.

After weeks of wallowing in self pity, she receives an offer to work for the celebrity chef, Gian O'Harthopp, in his restaurant... The "Garden of Caro." 

Will she be able to handle his unorthodox ways to success or will she be next on the chopping block?

[From [url=https://fruitbasketproductions.itch.io/garden-of-caro]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当卡罗琳因不公平的情况而失去副主厨的工作时，她陷入了自我怀疑和成堆的需要支付的账单之中。

经过数周的自怜自艾后，她收到了在名厨吉安·奥哈托普 (Gian O'Harthopp) 的餐厅“卡罗花园”工作的邀请。

她是否能够应对他非正统的成功之路，或者她会成为下一个被砍掉的人吗？

[来自[url=https://fruitbasketproductions.itch.io/garden-of-caro]itch.io[/url]]
